name: Elena Rodriguez
bio:
Elena Rodriguez discovered her passion for motorsport while helping her father, a mechanic, restore classic cars in their small village. This hands-on experience ignited a deep appreciation for precision and engineering, leading her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, she initially worked in the automotive industry, but her heart yearned for the high-octane world of racing. 

She transitioned to motorsport, starting as a junior technician, quickly proving her worth with her meticulous attention to detail and proactive problem-solving skills. Now at Tony Kart Racing, Elena meticulously oversees every aspect of kart preparation, ensuring that all components meet the highest standards. She believes in a holistic approach, focusing not only on identifying issues but also on understanding the root causes to prevent future failures. Her relentless pursuit of perfection is driven by a desire to provide the drivers with a machine they can fully trust. Elena's analytical mind and commitment to quality make her a valuable asset to the team.

Elena's demanding nature stems from her unwavering commitment to excellence. She isn't afraid to challenge established processes and suggest improvements, which often leads to better outcomes. Her colleagues know that if Elena signs off on something, it's been thoroughly vetted and meets the highest standards of quality.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elena is of average height with a lean, athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of double-checking everything, even after it's been inspected.
Prefers to work in silence, using noise-cancelling headphones.
